environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in production account. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS Aurora. The DB_USER is 'lambda_ro_7f3a' — a database role provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-iam-auth' with a pg_hba.conf entry restricting connection source to the Lambda ENI CIDR. The role was created with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO lambda_ro_7f3a; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO lambda_ro_7f3a; No additional privileges granted. REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC was applied. The role has NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOINHERIT set. Note: pg_hba.conf uses 'cert' auth method requiring IAM-based SSL client certificate, and the role's search_path is explicitly set to 'public' with no ability to create temp tables (REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA pg_temp FROM lambda_ro_7f3a). Connection pooling via RDS Proxy with pinning disabled.

config.db_user_grants: SELECT ONLY on public schema tables
